case_title: Aminuddin v. State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused, along with six others, attacked the victim, who was coming from his house to milk the cattle. The victim sustained eight grievous injuries, including incise wounds and stab wounds on and around the neck and chest. The victim died as a result of the injuries. The accused were identified as the assailants in the FIR. Two eyewitnesses were present at the scene. The accused were arrested or surrendered at different times. The trial court initially denied bail, and the High Court granted bail to one of the accused based on the bail granted to other co-accused. The Supreme Court overturned the High Court's decision, stating that the High Court failed to consider the serious nature of the crime and the relevant facts of the case.
